claim: Timebase — 60.10 Hz video, a "4 ms" VA11 IRQ, nap-scheduled processes: Source side: the PIA is initialized to interrupt on VA11's low-high edge only — "ENABLE PIA'S 4MS INTERUPT LOW-HIGH EDGE" (SYSTEM.SRC:95) — so the "4 ms" IRQ fires on a subset of VA11 toggles, ~4 per frame;
